# ChatGPT

1. In ChatGPT settings, turn on **Developer mode** (workspace admins may need to allow it first).
2. Add a new app/connector: name `Gupshup`, server URL `https://mcp.gupshup.ai/enterprise-auth/mcp`, authentication **OAuth**.
3. When prompted, sign in with your **Gupshup Enterprise account ID and password** for each channel (WhatsApp, SMS, RCS) you want to use, then choose which apps (Analytics, Templates, Campaigns) to allow.
4. In a chat, enable Gupshup from the tools menu.

Menu labels vary by plan and are changing as OpenAI rolls out apps; look for Developer mode under Settings.

No Gupshup Enterprise account yet? Email [sales@gupshup.ai](mailto:sales@gupshup.ai).

Something not working? See [Troubleshooting](../troubleshooting.md).
